description: Every Prospeo endpoint, plus a credit-aware local cache, bulk CSV pipelines, and lookalike search no other Prospeo tool ships.

tools.name: account_info
tools.description: Show current plan, remaining credits, used credits, next quota renewal, and team size. Free, does not consume credits. Returns the AccountInformation.

tools.name: company_bulk
tools.description: Enrich up to 50 companies in one call. Auto-chunks CSV input into 50-row requests with caller IDs. Required: items. Returns the new BulkCompanyEnrichment.

params.name: items
params.description: Array of company records (caller_id + matching fields). Max 50 per request.

tools.name: company_enrich
tools.description: Enrich a company by website, LinkedIn URL, or Prospeo company_id. 1 credit per match; misses and lifetime duplicates are free. Optional: website, linkedin, name (plus 1 more). Returns the new CompanyEnrichment.

params.name: website
params.description: Company website domain (strongest match)

params.name: linkedin
params.description: Company LinkedIn URL

params.name: name
params.description: Company name (discouraged alone; combine with location or industry)

params.name: company-id
params.description: Prospeo company ID from a prior /search-company hit

tools.name: company_search
tools.description: Search companies by industry, size, revenue, funding, tech stack, location, hiring signals (Growth+ for ICP filters). 25 per page, max 25,000 total. 1 credit per page with results. Required: filters. Optional: page (default: 1). Returns the new CompanySearch.

params.name: filters
params.description: Filter object. See https://prospeo.io/api-docs/filters-documentation

params.name: page
params.description: Page number (1-1000, 25 per page)

tools.name: person_bulk
tools.description: Enrich up to 50 person records in one call. Pass --input CSV with first_name/last_name/company columns (or linkedin_url). Auto-chunks into 50-row requests. Required: items. Optional: verified-only (default: false), mobile (default: false), verified-mobile-only (default: false). Returns the new BulkPersonEnrichment.

params.name: items
params.description: Array of person records (caller_id + matching fields). Max 50 per request; CLI auto-chunks larger inputs.

params.name: verified-only
params.description: Skip unverified email hits

params.name: mobile
params.description: Also resolve mobile phone (10 credits per record)

params.name: verified-mobile-only
params.description: Skip unverified mobile hits

tools.name: person_enrich
tools.description: Enrich a single person. Provide at least one matching path: linkedin_url, email, person_id, or first_name+last_name with a company hint. Costs 1 credit for email or 10 with --mobile. Optional: first-name, last-name, full-name (plus 9 more). Returns the new PersonEnrichment.

params.name: first-name
params.description: Person's first name (used with last_name + company)

params.name: last-name
params.description: Person's last name (used with first_name + company)

params.name: full-name
params.description: Full name (alternative to first_name + last_name)

params.name: company
params.description: Company name, website, or LinkedIn URL

params.name: company-name
params.description: Company name hint

params.name: company-website
params.description: Company website hint

params.name: linkedin
params.description: LinkedIn profile URL (strongest match signal)

params.name: email
params.description: Known email to enrich profile around

params.name: person-id
params.description: Prospeo person ID from a prior /search-person hit

params.name: verified-only
params.description: Skip unverified email hits to save credits

params.name: mobile
params.description: Also resolve mobile phone (10 credits instead of 1)

params.name: verified-mobile-only
params.description: Skip unverified mobile hits

tools.name: person_search
tools.description: Search Prospeo's people database with filters (job_title, seniority, department, company, location, ICP signals). Returns up to 25 hits per page; total cap 25,000. Costs 1 credit per page that returns results. Required: filters. Optional: page (default: 1).

params.name: filters
params.description: Filter object: include/exclude arrays for person_job_title, person_seniority, person_department, company.websites, company.names, person_location_search, etc. See https://prospeo.io/api-docs/filters-documentation

params.name: page
params.description: Page number (1-1000, 25 per page)

tools.name: suggestions_lookup
tools.description: Autocomplete for location or job title filters before composing a search. 15 req/s rate limit. Pass exactly one of --location or --job-title. Optional: location, job-title. Returns the new Suggestions.

params.name: location
params.description: Location prefix (min 2 chars). Returns COUNTRY/STATE/CITY/ZONE suggestions.

params.name: job-title
params.description: Job title prefix (min 2 chars). Returns up to 25 suggestions.
